description: Clean lines and open design define the Mackenzie Slat Back Crib, a stunning 4-in-1 convertible crib crafted from solid hardwood in a warm Brown Maple finish. The classic slat back brings an airy, light-filled feel to your nursery while providing the durability and safety you expect. Converts effortlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed, growing with your child from newborn through adolescence. Three adjustable mattress positions let you lower the mattress as your baby begins to sit and stand. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials that meet or exceed all CPSC and ASTM standards. Coordinates with the full Mackenzie collection including the panel back crib, dressers, chest, and nightstand. Assembly is straightforward with all hardware included.
